categories.main_business_segments: Li Cheng Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and wholesale of textiles, specializing in three-dimensional knitted fabrics. Their product applications include sports shoes, sportswear, automotive interiors, personal protective equipment, and women's underwear. The company also engages in yarn spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing, garment manufacturing, and international trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced three-layer spacer fabric technology characterized by high breathability, lightweight, shock absorption, and environmental friendliness. They utilize integrated fiber, weaving, and dyeing processes, employing computerized fabric design systems and innovative dyeing techniques. Their production emphasizes eco-friendly processes, including water and energy conservation, and they hold multiple patents related to fabric structures and dyeing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international sportswear brands such as Nike, Converse, Reebok, Asics, Brooks, and New Balance. The primary markets served include the sports shoe industry, sportswear, automotive seating, personal protective gear, and women's lingerie. The company targets both domestic and international clients, with a significant focus on the Asian market and expanding presence in Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Yunlin and Changhua, and an expanding production base in Vietnam. Sales are distributed across Asia, Europe, the Americas, and domestic Taiwan markets, with Asia accounting for the majority of exports. The company actively develops markets within ASEAN countries and maintains a global customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: Li Cheng Enterprise operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on fabric production and finishing. They source raw yarns from upstream suppliers and supply finished fabrics to downstream manufacturers such as shoe and garment producers. The company also engages in some downstream activities through garment and accessory manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in three-dimensional fabric technology, developing high-durability and jacquard fabric structures. R&D efforts focus on enhancing product functionality such as moisture-wicking, antibacterial, UV protection, and environmental sustainability. They emphasize project management, automation, and collaboration with brand customers to develop differentiated, high-value products while expanding R&D capabilities and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of knitted fabrics and related textile products to brand manufacturers and wholesalers. The company operates on a product sales model, including customized orders and contract manufacturing. They also derive income from related services such as dyeing and finishing, and from their subsidiaries engaged in textile-related businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Li Cheng Enterprise is positioned as a leading manufacturer of advanced three-dimensional spacer fabrics in Taiwan and holds a competitive edge through strong R&D, patented technologies, and stable relationships with major global brands. The company faces competition from textile manufacturers in Taiwan, China, South Korea, and Southeast Asia but maintains a niche in high-performance, eco-friendly fabrics with a diversified product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$970 million, a decline of about 24.7% from the previous year, and a net loss after tax of NT$235 million. Despite recent financial setbacks, Li Cheng continues to invest in capacity expansion, including its Vietnam facility, and R&D. The company has a stable asset base with total assets around NT$4.6 billion and is focused on long-term growth through market expansion and product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Li Cheng offers highly functional, lightweight, breathable, and environmentally friendly three-dimensional fabrics that provide superior shock absorption and comfort. Their products are differentiated by advanced textile technology, customization capabilities, and sustainable manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes close collaboration with global brand customers to tailor products that meet evolving market demands, ensuring high quality and innovation that enhance end-user experience.
